annotations.text: Settled by taking the cue slot's press: a cue pad is apply/stop — a toggle, lit from the stack's live cue, live without being the playhead — so solo has one meaning for every kind: pressing one turns its siblings off. The pinned pad's move-the-playhead press goes.

Settled for now: rows of columns of banks, widths as shares, a bank's pads wrapping or in one column. Still MagicQ's fixed grid rather than QLC+'s free canvas — nothing positioned by hand, nothing overlapping. If a page ever needs more, a pad size is the next lever, not coordinates.

Open: the library pages after this.

Drafted: flat lists by name, no groups, no drag order — the busk page is the only place order and grouping mean anything. Keep the family filter. Each row could show 'on 2 pages' as a hint.

Open: save per gesture vs on Done.

Drafted: per gesture, matching every other editor on the desk, with Done only leaving the mode. Cost: a mid-edit page is live for a second operator. Alternative: hold edits until Done, with a Discard.
Kept for the record. Alternative C was chosen on 2026-09-04; A and B are here so the reasoning is not lost. The first C sketch is below; the built-out version is on the other page.

Open: which Looks a slot may hold.

Drafted: a Look with no deferred effect — rows are always bound, so that is the whole test. Its press toggles it onto its own fixtures; the toggle route derives the targets. A busk-only Look is refused at assign, not at press.
